rules.erasure: Erasure check at block b (readout b = entering block b, after the edit): normalised SSDC N_b <= 0.1, and on held-out images exact probe <= 4.0x chance and row and column probes <= 1.5x chance (RB-6's thresholds). Where N_b is undefined (intact - floor too small) the probes decide. An erasure is complete if the check passes at every block 1-11.
rules.normalisation: N_b = (SSDC_b - floor_b) / (intact_b - floor_b), only where intact_b - floor_b >= 0.1; raw SSDC always reported. Floor = all rotations off (RoPE), both off (hybrid).
rules.top1: Top-1 cost = intact - arm in points on the same 5,000 images, with a paired SE; share = cost / (intact - floor).
rules.reading: Classifiers. C = top-1 cost of all_mean, C0 = top-1 cost of all_offset (mean's vectors at the wrong slots), F = cost of removing position entirely (rotations off; embedding zeroed; both in the hybrid). BARELY USED if C < 10% of F; USED if C >= 10% of F and C - C0 > 3 paired SE; CANNOT TELL otherwise. The statement covers the per-slot mean component only.
